data.title: Deferred - screen component split, and Signals Reassigned feedback loop

meta.title: Deferred - screen component split, and Signals Reassigned feedback loop
meta.description:
## Deliberate simplifications for this slice

1. **Assign Signal to Project (B1) has 2 visual components** (signal-context card, project radio list) fed by 2 different read models (SignalListView, ProjectListView). Per eventmodeling-identifying-outputs Step 5c, strict practice is to split this into 2 marked/highlighted screen copies, one per component. Kept as a single screen here since both fields groups are small and static-in-this-slice - flagging as accepted debt rather than fragmenting the model this early.
2. **Signals Reassigned (column D) is not wired back into SignalListView.** The platform only allows a later EVENT -> READMODEL backward connection when the read model already feeds an AUTOMATION (todo-list pattern) - SignalListView feeds screens only, so this would require a *new* SignalListView copy in/after column D plus a matching Signals List screen copy there (never a backward link to the existing instance). Deferred as future scope - the Signals List screen currently shown does not yet reflect live reassignment.
